required_installed_inventory: Fixed source-derived installation paths for exactly the four named binaries; complete held/named bytes SHA and dev/inode/mode/owner/link-count/mtime/ctime; do not accept an unqualified symlink.
Actual system and user service definitions and drop-ins selected by the service manager; exact executable/config references, InvocationID, MainPID and enabled/active state.
Current complete original Main guard before/after the read-only inventory; same B02/Q and all eight original process identities. No new process is adopted by a binary filename.

Presence/absence and bounded private interpretation of /usr/share/droidloom/package.json, the existing CLI's package-management marker. Its source meaning alone does not establish actual package ownership.
If package-managed: exact owning package versions and recoverable original package archives/database transaction authority. Four copied ELF backups alone do not qualify package rollback.
Artifact/source/config/Android image lineage and the old activation/deployment evidence remain immutable; a new deployment receipt is separate.

ordered_stages.actions: Read the actual new release report/38 command receipts, 15 independent test results, three lifecycle controls and six executable profiles; select only the four normal binaries.
Use the fixed source definitions plus actual installed inventory to choose one supported installation transaction. Resolve destinations and exact old-byte/package rollback material.
Create an isolated candidate/backup workspace; hash actual four candidate ELFs and all rollback material; write immutable transaction manifest. No replacement or service operation in this stage.

Prepare a deployment-aware baseline producer and new host/custom contexts. It must accept the explicit deployment receipt and observe a new authoritative service/owner/init chain; it must not relabel B02 as unchanged or deployment_performed=false.
Root presents exact four destination changes or package transaction, observed old/new hashes, service downtime, new-baseline plan and bounded rollback actions for final deployment approval.

After explicit approval, serialize against all users of current Main and use source-qualified lifecycle/service ordering. Verify stop completion. Perform the reviewed four-file/package transaction with per-step durable receipts and exact ownership; no unrelated file replacement.

Start via the qualified unchanged service configuration; verify installed hashes and actual running image identity. Observe authorized lifecycle Status and explicit fresh Readiness separately. Capture a complete new generation with stable resource/identity/parent tables before any App admission.

Bind the new current_discovery source hash and a new explicit baseline/schema/epoch into all real production entry points; preserve original full guards and the eight-second fresh readiness gate. Rebuild/reinstall only the necessary generation-bound helpers from newly qualified targets and fresh nonces.

rollback.eligibility: Only the exact original bundle or package archives qualified before replacement, with the same held/named identity and complete hashes.
sequence: Close admissions and preserve the failed new deployment outcome.
Use only the reviewed service stop path and verify its own process/cell retirement. Do not kill unrelated processes, clear unknown locks or remove task IDs from an earlier generation.
Restore the complete original four-file bundle or the qualified original package transaction. Preserve ownership/mode and verify every restored byte; retain partial-step/cleanup errors.
Restart using the original qualified service configuration only if that restart is included in approval.
Treat the restored software's process/cell identities as another new generation. Requalify a fresh baseline; old B02 or old task/UID/nonce authority never becomes current again.

explicit_nonclaims: Debug02 PASS does not make its six debug ELFs release artifacts.
A successful release build does not establish current installed Main source provenance, deployment permission or whole-App readiness.
The in-flight Status observation proves the observed parent-child conflict only; it does not establish the cause of the historical London launch failure.
New Status is authorized lifecycle observation, not Android-ready evidence. Readiness retains the prior fresh snapshot and failure semantics.
Restart or rollback cannot preserve the original eight live process identities by editing their expected values.
Unknown installed paths, original package archives, service ordering, release hashes and future baseline values are null until observed; no placeholder is dispatched.

packaging_decision.install_supervisor_reason: The exact source admits only aarch64, OnePlus aston and logix UID1001, and changes only three supervisor binaries plus cell/vold. It is not the current x86_64 four-binary transaction.
packaging_decision.install_runtime_reason: The exact source also changes Android runtime/image/data activation, Wayland, cell configuration, units, environment, policy and service enablement. Those changes are outside this four-binary repair.
packaging_decision.candidate_destination_source: packaging/install-runtime names /usr/bin for the four binaries, three /usr/lib/systemd units and /etc/droidloom/cell.json. Runtime paths are not adopted until observed.
packaging_decision.service_order_source_is_reference_only: install-runtime and install-supervisor stop the user session before the system daemon; current effective service configuration, all enabled user instances and actual retirement must still be qualified.

remaining_readonly_evidence.required_result: All fixed observations, original before/after Main and source/B/Q checks and FD closure complete; preserve missing/unsupported file states.

Service manager's actual system droidloomd and relevant user-session/catalog unit FragmentPath, DropInPaths, ExecStart, state, InvocationID/MainPID and applicable UID; fixed returned paths only. No guessed drop-in scan.

If a package marker is present or manager ownership is reported, qualify exact owning package/version, four-file correspondence and recoverable original archive/database transaction. A marker alone cannot select direct file replacement.

After destination and package branch are selected, prepare immutable old/new bundle and restore metadata in an isolated owned staging root; verify full hash and file identity. No service or installed-file mutation.

Separate deployment-aware schema rooted in exact approved receipt and authenticated new daemon/owner/init chain, stable all-eight identities and resource/image/source lineage; never edit old B02 or pretend no deployment.

mutation_manifest_requirements.selection: Only four named normal release executables; the two libtest/CLI test ELFs are excluded.
mutation_manifest_requirements.destination_paths: Each must be from actual installed-file/effective-service/package authority; source-derived candidate alone is insufficient.
mutation_manifest_requirements.old_byte_and_metadata_authority: Retain full bytes/hash/mode/uid/gid/dev/ino/link count/mtime_ns/ctime_ns from actual report. Preserve original integer tokens or parse with Python lossless integers, never through JS rounded nanoseconds.
mutation_manifest_requirements.backup: Distinct create-only backup names, verified complete old hashes, source parent identities, fsync and same-directory atomic replacement prerequisites recorded. Four independent renames are not claimed to be one atomic transaction.
mutation_manifest_requirements.first_error_and_partial_commit: Durable per-file step records identify every completed replacement. First error remains primary; rollback/stop/start failures are separate and cannot mark restoration complete.
mutation_manifest_requirements.package_branch: If managed, the reviewed transaction must use a qualified package path/rollback authority; raw four-file overwrite is not assumed acceptable.
mutation_manifest_requirements.action_boundary: No mutation request is generated until exact service/package branch, current Main guard, backup/staging, generation policy and final approval are all concrete.
